isolation_flags: source mounted read-only at /src, only /work is writable
verified_behaviors: Container has no network: an outbound TCP connection from inside fails
Source is mounted read-only: writing to /src is rejected and the host file is unchanged
The engine sees /src, never the host path, so host layout is not leaked into the result
A run past its deadline raises TimeoutError, force-removes the container and returns quickly
A result whose digest does not match its content is rejected
The generated argv contains every isolation flag before the image name
limitations: Shares the host kernel; this is container isolation, not a VM or a hardware sandbox
The production sandbox image was not built in this run, only the executor and its tests were exercised
No custom seccomp/AppArmor profile beyond Docker defaults plus no-new-privileges
A single container per task; no warm pool, so start-up latency is part of each run
